title.value: An act to add Chapter 12.5 (commencing with Section 108945) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to product safety. Juvenile Products
title.provenance: An act to add Chapter 12.5 (commencing with Section 108945) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to product safety. Juvenile Products

status.provenance: Approved by Governor October 5, 2021. Filed with Secretary of State October 5, 2021.

date.provenance: Approved by Governor October 5, 2021. Filed with Secretary of State October 5, 2021.

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or 'PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: On and after July 1, 2023, a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer, shall not sell or distribute in commerce in this state any new, not previously owned, juvenile product that contains regulated PFAS chemicals.

who.provenance: a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer, shall not sell or distribute in commerce in this state

action.provenance: shall not sell or distribute in commerce

value: child restraint system for use in motor vehicles and aircraft
polyurethane foam mat, pad, or pillow
products.provenance: a new, not previously owned, juvenile product

value: internal component of a juvenile product that would not come into direct contact with a child's skin or mouth during reasonably foreseeable use and abuse of the product
exceptions.provenance: Juvenile product' does not include any of the following: A children's electronic product, including, but not limited to, a personal computer, audio and video equipment, calculator, wireless phone, game console, handheld device incorporating a video screen, or any associated peripheral such as a mouse, keyboard, power supply unit, or power cord. A medical device. An internal component of a juvenile product that would not come into direct contact with a child's skin or mouth during reasonably foreseeable use and abuse of the product. An adult mattress.

intentionally_added.provenance: Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'regulated PFAS' means either of the following: (1) PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product, including, but not limited to, the PFAS components of intentionally added chemicals and PFAS that are intentional breakdown products of an added chemical that also have a functional or technical effect in the product.

type.provenance: A manufacturer shall use the least toxic alternative when replacing PFAS chemicals in a juvenile product in accordance with this chapter.

action.provenance: when replacing PFAS chemicals in a juvenile product
